question.text: Which event that Li Xiaofan and Zhao Xiaotang did together does the problem picture remind Li Xiaofan of?

questions.original_answer: Stray cats are spayed/neutered and then released back.

supporting_evidence.content: Yifan, look at all the tangible things we've accomplished together this year! I just compiled an electronic photo album titled "Summary of the 2024 XX Community Neighborhood Mutual Assistance Project" and sent it to you. This picture shows Big Orange after being neutered and released—still wearing the collar, but now full of energy, often basking in the sun in the neighborhood. Remember the late cold spell in March? That was when its mother was shivering on the concrete with three kittens, and we quickly made foam box shelters. Now it's become a community star—what a remarkable change.

Received! Wow, this photo album is really thoughtfully made, with both pictures and text. I see one photo of a stray cat being released after neutering, still wearing its collar. I remember we were worried about how it would adapt.
